provenance: PROVISIONAL. Visual judgements by Claude (Opus 5.5) from wide-context contact sheets of every SAM 3 track (one mid-track frame each), made 2026-10-23 BEFORE running the revised linker, for the cross-name / wearer / verification linking changes. Not owner labels; not checked by a person. Track ids are those of runs/ooo-genz-clip1/objects_sam3_tracks.npz. Wearers are named by the panel members' on-screen captions. One revision after seeing the crop check's views: the seven movie posters were moved from 'objects' to 'excluded' as edited-in graphics (each appears with a floating year caption and hovers over the stage in wide shots), not physical posters.
rules: Each entry of 'objects' is one physical object. Pairs of tracks in the same object are 'same'; tracks in different objects are 'different'. An 'unsure_groups' entry lists tracks that are certainly this person's items of this kind but cannot be told apart from the footage (two necklaces, several rings): pairs inside it are 'unsure'. Tracks in 'excluded' (ambiguous boxes, boxes on printed or on-screen images, a track spanning two people) are 'unsure' with every track. Pairs on screen together are decided by the cannot-link rule, so scores use linkable pairs only.
